Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, involving two vehicles traveling in the same lane of a
city street. Driver 1 was stopped at a signal when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of Driver 1's car.
Driver 2 stated that braking came too late to avoid contact, and Driver 1 gave a matching account of the sequence.
Two witnesses at the scene described the impact the same way, and photographs taken at the location show
rear-end damage on Driver 1's vehicle that fits the reported force of the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the left
knee, which struck the lower dash on impact, and that injury is consistent with a crash of this kind. Passenger, seated
in the front right seat, was confirmed to be in the vehicle at the time. Officers found no sign of earlier damage to either
vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle involved. Both drivers were
cooperative, exchanged information, and were transported no further than the scene.
</page>
